$1\,\dfrac 1 {3}=\dfrac{(3\times 1)+1}{3}= \dfrac43$
- We also write $1\,\dfrac25$ as an improper fraction:
$1\,\dfrac25=\dfrac{(5\times 1)+2}{5}= \dfrac75$

**Step 2:** Multiply the fractions by multiplying the numerators and denominators separately:

$$
\dfrac43\times\dfrac75= \dfrac {4\times 7} {3\times 5} = \dfrac{28}{15}
$$

**Step 3:** Simplify or convert back to a mixed number, if necessary:

$$
\dfrac{28}{15} = 1 \, \text{R} 13 = 1 \, \dfrac{13}{15}
$$

$$
